Look at the LLVM IR pane for dxc. `DerivCoarseX(value)` (the ddx call) is
computed from `value`, which does not depend on the branch condition at all.
Check whether the `call float @dx.op.unary.f32(i32 83, ...)` line that names
DerivCoarseX appears BEFORE the `br i1` (correct: computed once, for every
lane, before the branch) or AFTER it, inside the conditional successor block
(the bug: the compiler moved/"sank" the call into the branch, so only lanes
that take it ever execute the derivative -- which corrupts the value, since
a quad/wave derivative needs every lane in the group to run it together).
